import asyncio


# CASE while_true_nested_for_in_try expect=fire
async def drain_try(queue, items):
    while True:
        try:
            for item in items:
                await save(item)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


# CASE while_true_nested_for_in_if expect=fire
async def drain_if(queue, items, ready):
    while True:
        if ready:
            for item in items:
                await save(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


# CASE while_true_nested_for_in_async_with expect=fire
async def drain_with(lock, items):
    while True:
        async with lock:
            for item in items:
                await save(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


# CASE while_true_sync_inner_then_await expect=pass
async def poll(queue):
    while True:
        batch = []
        for item in queue.pending():
            batch.append(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


# CASE while_true_nested_for_direct expect=fire
async def drain_direct(items):
    while True:
        for item in items:
            await save(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


# CASE for_nested_while_await expect=fire
async def nested_while(groups):
    for group in groups:
        while group.more():
            await group.fetch()


# CASE with_nested_async_for expect=pass
async def stream(conn):
    with conn:
        async for row in conn.rows():
            await handle(row)


# CASE sync_inner_for_then_sync expect=pass
async def build(groups):
    for group in groups:
        for item in group:
            print(item)


# CASE while_true_inner_for_awaited_else expect=fire
async def drain_else(items):
    while True:
        for item in items:
            await save(item)
        else:
            pass
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


# CASE for_nested_for_comment_then_await expect=fire
async def nested_comment(groups):
    for group in groups:
        # each item is saved
        for item in group:
            await save(item)
